rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Dedicated statute with rights equal to the general labor law.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Registration required; written contract not required.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: Minimum pay set by the National Commission for Private Household Work.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura

rules.v: Normal hours limited as for other workers
rules.vi: Jam kerja normal dibatasi seperti pekerja lain

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi

rules.v: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh memilih tinggal di luar; akomodasi di rumah harus layak dan privat
rules.n: Live-in or live-out; private and decent accommodation.

rules.v: Worker may change employer without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh pindah tanpa persetujuan pemberi kerja
rules.n: Migration status not tied to one employer.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Labor tribunal for private household work.

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan
rules.n: Social security, maternity and work injury.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat

decisions.nm: Reyes Aguilera, Daniela c/ Estado Nacional
decisions.pe: A girl from Bolivia with a severe disability had lived in Argentina since 1999. She was refused a disability pension because foreigners needed 20 years of residence. The Supreme Court said that rule was unconstitutional.
decisions.pi: Seorang anak perempuan dari Bolivia dengan disabilitas berat tinggal di Argentina sejak 1999. Ia ditolak pensiun disabilitas karena orang asing harus tinggal 20 tahun. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.

decisions.nm: Repetto, Inés María c/ Provincia de Buenos Aires
decisions.pe: A foreign national barred from teaching in private schools.
decisions.pi: Warga asing dilarang mengajar di sekolah swasta.

decisions.nm: Hooft, Pedro Cornelio Federico c/ Provincia de Buenos Aires
decisions.pe: Naturalized citizens barred from a provincial judicial post; strict scrutiny of origin-based distinctions.
decisions.pi: Warga naturalisasi dilarang menduduki jabatan peradilan provinsi; pengujian ketat atas pembedaan berdasarkan asal.

decisions.nm: Gottschau, Evelyn Patrizia c/ Consejo de la Magistratura
decisions.pe: A foreign resident excluded from a court clerk competition because of nationality.
decisions.pi: Penduduk asing dikecualikan dari seleksi panitera pengadilan karena kewarganegaraan.

decisions.nm: Raghda Habal and son v. Argentina
decisions.pe: A Syrian-born woman was summarily expelled from Argentina after her naturalization was annulled. The Commission held that due process guarantees (American Convention arts. 8 and 25) apply to expulsion proceedings, and found violations. Details to be confirmed against the report.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan kelahiran Suriah diusir secara seketika dari Argentina setelah naturalisasinya dibatalkan. Komisi menyatakan bahwa jaminan proses hukum (Pasal 8 dan 25 Konvensi Amerika) berlaku dalam proses pengusiran, dan menemukan pelanggaran.
